title: Brand registry
description: catalog/brands.json — canonical brand slugs and display labels. Exists because the catalog currently carries 55 distinct name-tails for roughly 30 brands, model names having been fused into the brand string ('Nike Shox Neymar'), and because an authoring form needs a dropdown source.

brands.description: Slug -> brand. The slug is the image-folder name, so it is lowercase and hyphenated.

label.description: Display name, as it should appear to a customer. May legitimately differ from the slug where the on-disk folder preserves a misspelling — 'under-armor' labels as 'Under Armour'.
